measured.machine: Apple M2 Max, 12 cores, 64 GiB, macOS 26.6.2
measured.how: target/release/quickertype <input> -l ts -o <file> (the Scryfall cards with --just-types -t Cards), the runs of each command in turn, after one untimed run (none for quicktype on the 657 MB cards); wall time and peak RSS of each run from wait4, medians of 3 to 15 runs. Time and peak memory are on all cores, the default; on one thread, QUICKTYPE_READ_THREADS=1 reads every sample in one go. quicktype is its CLI on the same input, with the same options. Every command wrote the same output. How each input is made: docs/BENCHMARKS.md, "Large inputs".

unfinished.why: quicktype stalls on this file after about 3 minutes: once it has seen 8,388,608 distinct strings, Node.js re-sorts quicktype's whole table of strings for every new one, about 1.3 s each. More memory doesn't help.
